proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: both sides sit inside the identification of lemma-extend-q-to-spaces; it suffices to show that properness of the scheme-theoretic support of Q over T is equivalent to properness of the support of the pullback over U for a surjective etale U -> T; this follows from the descent of properness combined with the flat-pullback-support lemma (support commutes with flat base change) (source lines 2505-2527)
